content.title: who should join
points: Aspiring & Current Project Managers: Gain skills to lead projects effectively.
Team Leaders: Improve planning and execution capabilities.
Functional Managers (Ops, IT, Marketing): Streamline project workflows and align with business goals.
Entrepreneurs: Oversee initiatives and startups efficiently.
Consultants: Adopt structured methodologies for client projects.
Business Analysts: Transition into project management roles.

content.title: program snapshot
points: 9 Modules - Project Planning, Risk Management, and Project Procurement
Learn From The Top Industry Professionals

curriculum.title: Business Economics for Strategic Decisions
points: Dynamics of market demand and supply
Cost Structure, Scale Economies, and Learning Curve
Economics of multi sided platforms and new disruptive business models
Understanding Macroeconomic and Global Business Environment

curriculum.title: Financial Acumen for Project Leaders
points: Project finance structures and use cases
NPV, IRR, payback, and valuation challenges
Risk modelling and financial sensitivity analysis

curriculum.title: Strategic Project Planning & Execution Leadership
points: Gantt charts and visual control mechanisms
Scheduling under uncertainty – PERT, Monte Carlo Simulations

curriculum.title: Agile Project Management for Delivery Excellence
points: Scrum roles, ceremonies, and execution discipline
User stories and backlog prioritization (with GenAI)
Agile metrics, velocity, and predictability tracking

curriculum.title: Digital, Legal & ESG for Project Leaders
points: CyberRisk Management in the Digital Age
General Principles of Contract – Legal perspective
ESG and Sustainability – Implications for Projects

curriculum.title: Leadership, Stakeholder Management & Communication
points: Leading Through Stakeholders: Managing Relationships That Matter
From Differences to Strength: Team Building in a Diverse Workplace
